initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; if(e.revealMesh.material) e.revealMesh.material.depthWrite=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);

steps.label: hideWu
steps.js: (function(){ try { if(window.__labWuMesh) window.__labWuMesh.visible=false; if(window.__labWuGround) window.__labWuGround.visible=false; if(window.__labAurora) window.__labAurora.visible=false; var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh) e.revealMesh.visible=false; return JSON.stringify({wuHidden:!window.__labWuMesh||!window.__labWuMesh.visible}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.label: probeScene
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var sc=e&&(e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene)); var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var V3=cam.position.constructor; var wp=new V3(); var named=[]; sc.traverse(function(o){ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; var n=o.name||''; if(!n) return; if(n.indexOf('Grass_chunk')===0) return; if(n.indexOf('Foliage_chunk')===0) return; o.getWorldPosition(wp); if(wp.y<-20||wp.y>30) return; named.push({n:n.slice(0,32), x:+wp.x.toFixed(1), y:+wp.y.toFixed(1), z:+wp.z.toFixed(1)}); }); named.sort(function(a,b){return a.y-b.y;}); return JSON.stringify({cam:[+cam.position.x.toFixed(1),+cam.position.y.toFixed(1),+cam.position.z.toFixed(1)], objs:named.slice(0,40)}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()
